sources.title: ananddey/gemma-4-E2B-asm-init · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The base model (google/gemma-4-E2B) has been prepared for Assamese pretraining by replacing the tokenizer and warm-initializing the embedding table via FOCUS. Train it on Assamese corpus (e.g. AsmCorpus) to produce a full Assamese language model.
